sources.quote: BR-220 at TO1 for STL has one approved material source: Alluminio B S.r.l. (Settimo Torinese).
APPROVAL AP-0311: part BR-220; plant TO1; customer STL; supplier Alluminio B S.r.l. (Settimo Torinese)
Alluminio B wants to ship the BR-220 billet from its Rovereto plant to catch up.

findings.why: The only approval for BR-220 at TO1 for STL is for Alluminio B at Settimo Torinese. The approval is tied to the supplier location, and the ASL has no approval for the Rovereto plant. The record does cover this part, plant and customer, so the absence means Rovereto is not approved.

sources.quote: Material certificates are not stored in this record.
Yield strength Rp0.2 >= 250 MPa. SPECIAL CHARACTERISTIC SC-01, controlled per control plan CP-BR220-R3.

findings.why: No certificate or test result exists in the documents for the 6082-T6 billet from Rovereto. Without one, nobody can confirm it meets Rp0.2 >= 250 MPa (SC-01). A person must supply the certificate or the test result.
